Why ultrasound matters before LVA

page4705.old_content: Compression advice must be individualised. Some patients continue compression garments or bandaging after a defined early period; others may need adjustments based on swelling, wound healing and surgeon preference. LVA should not be framed as a assured way to stop compression permanently.

page4705.old_content: Patients should seek medical advice for fever, spreading redness, increasing pain, wound discharge, sudden swelling, calf pain, breathlessness or other concerning symptoms. Recurrent cellulitis is clinically important and should be discussed during lymphedema follow-up.
